title: Things only long distance couples understand

slides.title: Things only *long distance* couples understand
slides.sub: If you’ve ever fallen asleep on a call, this one’s for you.

items.title: Falling asleep *on call.*
items.body: Then waking up to a six-hour call log.

items.title: Your phone is *basically them.*
items.body: Five percent battery feels like an emergency.

items.title: Your good morning is *their good night.*
items.body: You’ve memorized their time zone better than your own.

items.title: Airports are *emotional.*
items.body: Arrivals: the best place on earth. Departures: the worst.

items.title: The countdown is *sacred.*
items.body: Every crossed-off day is a tiny win.

items.title: Your couple photos are *screenshots.*
items.body: And honestly? They’re still the cutest ones.

items.title: You save places *for later.*
items.body: Every café, every view: “we’re going here when you visit.”

items.title: The first hug *hits different.*
items.body: Months of waiting, gone in one second.

slides.title: Save this *and send it across the miles.*
slides.sub: They’ll get it. They’re living it too.
